title: CRUD Service with Error Handling
description: Build a PostService with full CRUD, error handling, and a reactive component.
problemStatement:
Create a service to manage blog posts (using JSONPlaceholder as mock API). Implement full CRUD and display posts in a component with optimistic UI updates.

**Requirements:**
1. `PostService` with methods:
   - `getPosts(): Observable<Post[]>`
   - `createPost(post: Partial<Post>): Observable<Post>`
   - `updatePost(id: number, changes: Partial<Post>): Observable<Post>`
   - `deletePost(id: number): Observable<void>`
2. Handle errors in each method with `catchError`, re‑throwing a user‑friendly error message.
3. In `PostListComponent`, inject `PostService`, load posts on init.
4. Display posts with a delete button. On delete, remove the post from the local array optimistically (without re‑fetching all).
5. Provide an "Add Post" form that calls `createPost` and pushes the new post to the array.
6. Show an error message if any operation fails.
hints: Post interface: `{ id: number, title: string, body: string }`.
Error handling: use `catchError(error => throwError(() => 'Failed to load posts'))`.
For optimistic delete: `this.posts = this.posts.filter(p => p.id !== id)` after calling service.
Use `take(1)` if subscribing manually to avoid leaks.
expectedOutput: Posts list with delete and add functionality; errors shown if server fails.
